We need to initiate a full purge for the NovaSearch project (project ID NS-7783). Questions:

Please let us know the earliest possible date you can run the sweep and any requirements on our side (IP allowlists, scheduled account lockouts, POA).

Thanks,

Hi Sara — thanks for the clear scope. We're able to run this but want to confirm an agreed orchestration to minimize risk and provide the evidence package you requested. Proposed plan below; please confirm the window and any legal wording needs before we proceed.

Intake & timeline
- Intake ticket: RDW-4521 (I created it just now).
- Proposed sweep window: Mon Aug 11, 2025 02:00–06:00 UTC (4h maintenance window) — please confirm acceptance.

High-level purge workflow (what Redwood will do)
1) Pre-snapshot: create immutable audit snapshot of index/metadata for NS-7783.
2) Pause writes: briefly pause write access to the NovaSearch model routes (0–2 min) to ensure no new artifacts during sweep.
3) KV cache & prefix cache eviction for NS-7783 keys.
4) Sweep job: delete prompt & output records from the prompt-output store, remove matching objects in S3 using object manifest, and remove token-level logs from log storage per retention mapping.
5) Post-checks: run verification job to confirm counts and generate a signed manifest + checksum.
6) Evidence delivery: we will provide a CSV manifest, a PDF certificate (signed by Redwood security), and an audit log extract.

Rollback & risk
- We will hold a 24-hour rollback snapshot for operations team only; manifest and evidence will note snapshot IDs and TTL.
- Expected customer impact: short (~2 min) write pause; read/serving unaffected for cached responses.

Attachments
- sweep_manifest_template.csv (template for the manifest we will produce).

Next steps
- Confirm the Aug 11 window and whether Novapulse legal requires specific certificate wording or a notarized signature.
- If OK, we'll schedule the sweep and follow up with a final pre-sweep notice 24 hours prior.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Novapulse purge — technical plan and verification checklist

Hannah / team,

Putting down the ops checklist for RDW-4521. I will own the sweep run and verification with Priyom on evidence packaging. Key steps & commands (internal shorthand):

Pre-sweep (T-24h)
- Snapshot metadata: run: redwood snapshot create --project NS-7783 --tag rdw-4521-pre --retention 24h
- Notify infra & block scheduled model pushes for the window.

Sweep run (during window)
1) Pause writes: redwood route lock --route nova-search --reason "compliance purge"
2) KV eviction: redwood cache evict --prefix ns:ns-7783 --force
3) Prompt/output deletion: redwood store delete --project NS-7783 --filter "type in (prompt,output)" --batch-size 5000 --dry-run=false
4) S3 object deletion: run s3-batch-delete using manifest produced by query-id Q-4521. Manifest location: s3://redwood-purges/rdw-4521/manifest.csv
5) Log pruning: run log-prune --project NS-7783 --older-than 1970-01-01 --confirm

Verification (immediate post-run)
- Run verification script: scripts/verify_purge.py --manifest s3://redwood-purges/rdw-4521/manifest.csv --project NS-7783
- Output: verification_report.json, checksum SHA256 of manifest
- Evidence: bundle manifest CSV + verification_report.json into deletion_evidence_20250811.pdf (signed)

Notes/risks
- The S3 batch delete is irreversible once completed. We will keep pre-sweep snapshot with restricted TTL and note snapshot ID in the evidence.
- If manifest deletion hits >500k objects, expect job to take longer than 4h; we will scale workers but will notify Novapulse if we exceed window.

Priyom: can you own evidence assembly and the signed certificate (coordinate with legal)?

--
Marcus Lin
Senior Site Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
